name: Pumble
one_liner: Pumble is a team communication platform that offers a REST API via API keys and an official MCP server for AI integration.
auth_notes: API key is passed as a bearer token in the Authorization header.
access_notes: API keys can be generated by any workspace owner, admin or member after installing the API addon.

evidence.snippet: generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.
The Pumble API addon provides simple HTTP endpoints to handle messaging actions inside your workspace.

With the Pumble Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, you can connect third-party AI agents (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Codex) to Pumble and let them access content so they can search messages, find information, and take actions on your behalf.
To interact with the API, you must first generate an API key within your Pumble workspace administration panel.
